evidence.title: GitHub - nocodb/nocodb: 🔥 🔥 🔥 A Free & Self-hostable Airtable Alternative · GitHub

name: NocoDB
summary: Self-hostable no-code platform that turns SQL databases into an Airtable-style spreadsheet interface.
description: Connects to existing Postgres, MySQL or SQLite databases and gives them a spreadsheet UI with grid, gallery, form, kanban and calendar views, field types such as links, lookup, rollup and formula, and role-based access control with public or password-protected shares. Installs with Docker, a binary or the auto-upstall script; REST APIs, an SDK and an app store of Slack, email and storage integrations come with it.
contains: turns existing Postgres/MySQL/SQLite databases into a spreadsheet UI
views: grid (default), gallery, form, kanban, calendar
field types incl. links, lookup, rollup, attachment, formula, currency
roles and fine-grained access control; public, private or password-protected shares
REST APIs and an SDK; Docker, binaries or one-command auto-upstall
free plan up to 3 users; Plus from $12 per seat/month
